boundary: Post-delivery oracle only. Alternative witnesses denote manually authored equivalent source assertions, not model predictions.

witness_sets.text: Records whose commit was acknowledged survive a worker restart.
A worker restart preserves records with an acknowledged commit.
The page cache may be discarded after restart; cached data without a commit acknowledgement is not durable.
The public endpoint listens on port 8121.
Port 8121 is used by the public endpoint.
The administration endpoint listens on port 8122.
The commit acknowledgement is sent only after the journal flush completes.
The checkpoint moves only after acknowledgement is confirmed.
Moving the checkpoint before acknowledgement is confirmed can skip an uncommitted record.
An access link remains valid for 14 minutes.
The normal lifetime of an access link is 14 minutes.
Revocation invalidates the link immediately, even before the 14-minute expiry.
Production snapshots are retained for 21 days.
Staging snapshots are retained for 2 days, not 21 days.
The production retention rule does not apply to staging snapshots.
A successful checksum verification permits retry of the same immutable payload.
Retrying the same immutable payload is permitted when checksum verification succeeds.
A failed checksum verification does not permit retry; an operator must inspect the payload.
Submit an invoice within 17 days after the billing period closes.
